subject: Duplicate charges on our account
body: To the billing team, I am writing about a recurring overcharging problem on our account with the Pro annual plan. On March 3rd we upgraded from Starter to Pro because our team of twelve needed extra seats and the larger storage limit. The annual Pro invoice for that upgrade was 1,299 dollars and it was paid in full with the corporate card ending in 4412. Then on April 12th the system charged the same card again for the identical annual Pro plan, and on May 2nd it charged a third time for a renewal that should not happen until early next year. Our statement now shows three separate charges for the same annual plan, totaling more than 3,800 dollars, and at least two of them look like duplicates that should be reversed. I contacted support on May 5th and only received an automated acknowledgement, and the duplicate charges are still on our statement today. This is the second time in twelve months that our account has been double charged, and the repeated mistakes are making us lose confidence in the accuracy of the invoicing system. Please review the full payment history on our account, confirm which charges are duplicates, reverse the duplicated charges, and confirm in writing that our renewal schedule is now correct. I am happy to provide bank statements and the invoice numbers from our statement if that helps you investigate. A small credit for the inconvenience would be appreciated but is not required, and honestly my main ask is simply that the duplicate charges are reversed and that our billing history is corrected going forward. Thank you for your patience and for looking into this. We look forward to written confirmation of the correction by the end of this week.
